title: A node `Core\Ast::parse` returns is not an instance of `Core\Ast\Node`, its declared type.
text: `Core\Ast::parse`, `children` and `nodes` are declared to return `Core\Ast\Node`, and each node is an instance of its production's class (`PRODUCTIONS`), whose descriptor has no parent. So `mixed $m = Core\Ast::parse('<?nvs echo 2;'); echo $m is Core\Ast\Node ? "node" : "not a node";` prints `not a node`, and a `catch` or an `as Core\Ast\Node` on a node fails the same way. The checked build stops at every read of a parsed node (`NOVIS_CHECK_TYPES=1 nvs test tests/conformance/core/`, twelve `core-ast-*` cases). Closing it gives each production's descriptor `Core\Ast\Node` as its parent, with a conformance case for the `is` test.
